notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least seven.
description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If your devotion to green is at least eight, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.
